songs.title: Whose House (Houston Cougars)
songs.genre: Stadium hype anthem, drumline and marching-band brass, distorted power chords under the chorus, gang vocals, rock-rap verses
songs.extra: Stadium anthem for a 40,000-seat crowd. Big live drumline with tom hits and snare rolls, marching-band brass stabs, distorted guitar power chords under every chorus. Verses: lead rapper rides the beat with hard punchy consonants and confident aggressive swagger. Pre-chorus: rising brass and a snare roll into a hard drop. Chorus: shouted gang vocals, dozens of voices, stadium reverb, crowd stomps and claps on 2 and 4. Chants and call-and-response lines sound like a real crowd through a PA, slightly distant and roomy. Bridge: half-time feel, drums thin out, crowd answers the lead. Final chorus: key up a whole step, full volume. End on a drumline cadence and crowd chant, not a fade. The Whose house / Coogs' house chant is slow and deliberate like a real stadium crowd, two beats on the call, two beats on the answer, three times, The third call and answer is its own held section: the crowd drags every syllable out, roughly twice as long as the first two, like the last line of a stadium chant before kickoff. Pronounce Coogs to rhyme with moves, TDECU as the letters T-D-E-C-U, Yeoman as YO-man. Lines tagged lead rapper alone are one clear voice with no crowd layer, every word intelligible; only the chant sections are crowd vocals.
songs.avoid: slow tempo, ballad feel, acoustic guitar, piano intro, soft or breathy vocals, autotune, trap hi-hat rolls, EDM synth leads, 808 bass as the main bass, mumbled or slurred lyrics, skipping lines, repeating a verse twice, fade-out ending, female lead, child voices, sad or melancholy mood, mentioning any other team or city, altering the lyrics or adding ad-libs that are not written
songs.lyrics:
[Intro chant, crowd only, drumline underneath, two steady call-and-answers 8s]
Whose house? ... Coogs' house!
Whose house? ... Coogs' house!

[Intro chant held, crowd only, every word stretched long and slow, drumline roll 10s]
Whoooooooose... hoooooouse? ... Coooooooooogs'... hoooooouse!

[Intro tag, lead rapper alone, crowd silent, clear articulated spoken shout, every word distinct 5s]
Scarlet and white! Third Ward! Houston, Texas!

[Verse 26s]
Down on Cullen Boulevard the ground starts shakin'
Forty thousand deep, TDECU's wakin'
Since 1927 we been buildin' this thing
Shasta's on the prowl, hear the whole city sing
Fold that ring finger, throw the Paw to the sky
A cougar lost a toe, now the legend won't die
One-thirty-two to one-forty, lower bowl, hear it swell
Student section on its feet, loudest in the Big 12

[Pre-Chorus 8s]
Spirit of Houston, brass hits like thunder
Red Out in the stands, we gon' pull 'em under
Hands up, Paw up, Houston on the rise
Look 'em in the eye and go

[Chorus, gang vocals 16s]
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Whose house? Coogs' house!
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Scarlet and white, we don't back down!
Go Coogs! Go Coogs!
H-Town's team, we run this town!

[Post-Chorus, crowd chant over brass 6s]
Houston! (Houston!) Houston! (Houston!)
Paw up, red out, this is Coog town!

[Verse 26s]
Yeoman drew the veer, changed the game forever
Andre Ware took the Heisman, '89, best ever
Keenum threw it up, records fell like rain
New names on the jersey, same fire, same flame
Cougar Red Friday, whole city in the colors
Third Ward to the Bay, we ride for each other
Nobody gave us nothin', we took it, that's the story
Houston built on grit, Houston built for glory

[Pre-Chorus 8s]
Spirit of Houston, brass hits like thunder
Red Out in the stands, we gon' pull 'em under
Hands up, Paw up, Houston on the rise
Look 'em in the eye and go

[Chorus, gang vocals 16s]
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Whose house? Coogs' house!
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Scarlet and white, we don't back down!
Go Coogs! Go Coogs!
H-Town's team, we run this town!

[Post-Chorus, crowd chant over brass 6s]
Houston! (Houston!) Houston! (Houston!)
Paw up, red out, this is Coog town!

[Drumline Break, instrumental, crowd clapping on 2 and 4 8s]

[Bridge, half-time, crowd call and response 16s]
When I say Cougar, you say Pride!
Cougar! (Pride!) Cougar! (Pride!)
When I say Houston, you say Fight!
Houston! (Fight!) Houston! (Fight!)
Scott Street to I-45, Third Ward to the Bay
Spirit of Houston in the house, every Coog, stand up and say

[Final Chorus, full stadium, key up 16s]
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Whose house? Coogs' house!
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Scarlet and white, we don't back down!
Go Coogs! Go Coogs!
H-Town's team, we run this town!

[Chorus repeat, crowd only, drums and claps 10s]
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Whose house? Coogs' house!
Eat 'em up, Coogs, eat 'em up!
Scarlet and white, we don't back down!

[Outro chant, crowd only, drumline cadence, two steady call-and-answers 8s]
Whose house? ... Coogs' house!
Whose house? ... Coogs' house!

[Outro chant held, crowd only, every word stretched long and slow, final drum hit 10s]
Whoooooooose... hoooooouse? ... Coooooooooogs'... hoooooouse!

[Outro tag, lead rapper alone, crowd silent, clear spoken shout 3s]
Go Coogs!
